title: Model Adaptation
summary: Enables flexible model input preparation through adapters and data augmentation. Transforms raw instances into model-ready prompts while applying perturbations for robustness testing.

nodes.label: Receive Benchmark Instances
nodes.title: Instance intake
nodes.description: Accepts benchmark instances containing input text, references, and metadata from scenarios.

nodes.label: Select Adaptation Strategy
nodes.title: Adapter factory
nodes.description: Routes instances to appropriate adapter based on task type (generation, classification, multiple-choice) and model requirements.

nodes.label: Construct Model Prompts
nodes.title: Prompt building
nodes.description: Formats instances into model-specific prompts, handling in-context examples, instructions, and token constraints.

nodes.label: Apply Data Augmentations
nodes.title: Perturbation system
nodes.description: Applies text transformations (typos, contractions, dialect shifts, gender terms) to test model robustness across input variations.

nodes.label: Emit Adapted Prompts
nodes.title: Prompt output
nodes.description: Returns model-ready prompts with optional augmented variants for inference and evaluation.

groups.label: Adaptation Pipeline
groups.title: End-to-end adaptation
groups.description: Transforms benchmark instances into model-ready prompts with optional robustness augmentations.
